scope: All 88 Functional outcomes only; local composite evidence, not an LLM score
criterion_hash_definition: SHA-256 of the Python json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) UTF-8 representation used by launch_workflow.py; source_block_sha256 separately binds the exact TOML criterion block.

all_current_criteria.description: S01.startup_ready: Useful starting source automatically produces preview and console output without Run.
S01.usable_examples: A chosen built-in example supplies editable source and working output; an authored edit actually executes.
S01.example_separate: The edited example saves as a separate exact user record; reloading the built-in example preserves its original filename/source.
S02.js_html_filename_dispatch: JS and complete HTML execute in the mode selected by filename alone. Lowercase fallback isolates case handling.
S02.css_apply_snapshot: CSS applies to a fresh copy of the last successful document, preserving its content and prior authored style.
S02.extension_case: Uppercase .JS, .HTML and .CSS dispatch correctly without selecting a separate language.
S02.js_fresh_document: The later JS Run contains neither the old heading nor oldGlobal. S04 does not score freshness again.
S02.css_inert_copy: CSS neither reruns the proven old script nor carries its proven handler; neither marker count increases.
S03.later_interactions: After each six-second idle interval, the completed preview handles the click and later focused key/input without rerunning source.
S03.completed_stop: Stop ends the completed preview's handlers, reports stopped and permits a new Run. Removed/static/disabled controls are valid.
S04.supersede_pending: B supersedes genuinely pending A: A's delayed output, DOM and success never become current. Fresh globals are owned by S02.
S04.stop_pending_execution: Stop reports cancellation, prevents the active timer's late output and permits a new Run. Rollback is separate.
S04.stop_pending_rollback: Stopping the active timer retains/restores B's completed render; provisional candidate display is optional.
S05.preview_origin_boundary: All four parent-document/storage operations are blocked, actual host state is unchanged, and own-document execution remains usable.
S06.working_files_private: All nine bounded candidates avoid private-file exposure under S06's public-role, denial, fallback and ambiguity rules; healthy controls succeed.
S07.snippet_network_boundary: With matching transport controls, separate fetch/Image runs visibly refuse access with no extra deliveries/content; ordinary execution recovers.
S08.harmless_scope_words: The HTML control's ordinary strings/comments/text containing unsupported-family words renders and logs successfully.
S08.unsupported_execution_refused: Each of the five separate unsupported-family probes is clearly refused, preserves the good render and permits ordinary recovery.
S09.literal_loop_deadline: Both literal loops terminate within the allowed budget margin with a time-limit reason, early logs preserved and successful recovery.
S09.literal_loop_rollback: Each loop timeout retains/restores recorded currentLastGood rather than a failed or empty candidate.
S10.js_error_message: The console identifies the not-a-function error involving forEeach.
S10.js_error_line: The error identifies line 4 of the exact entered JS source, without wrapper offsets.
S10.js_error_rollback: The JS failure restores recorded currentLastGood, not failed-partial-dom; an ordinary recovery Run works.
S11.html_error_message: The console identifies undefinedFunctionCall from the complete HTML source.
S11.html_error_line: The error identifies line 6 of the exact complete HTML document, including its markup.
S11.html_error_rollback: The HTML failure restores recorded currentLastGood, not Failed HTML candidate; an ordinary recovery Run works.
S12.timer_error_message: The timer callback's thrown async-error-marker is reported as a failure.
S12.timer_error_line: The timer error identifies entered user-source line 2.
S12.timer_error_rollback: The timer failure restores recorded currentLastGood, not async-failed-candidate; an ordinary recovery Run works.
S13.promise_error_message: The unhandled promise-error-marker rejection is reported as a failure.
S13.promise_error_line: The unhandled rejection identifies entered user-source line 2.
S13.promise_error_rollback: The rejection restores recorded currentLastGood, not promise-failed-candidate; an ordinary recovery Run works.
S14.console_level_stream: The four authored console levels have their exact values, order and unambiguous level indicators; console.error alone is a log.
S15.console_value_inspection: App controls expose object properties, nested deep value and array elements rather than opaque summaries.
S16.console_history: Earlier log entries remain across successive Runs until cleared.
S16.console_duration: The completed Run shows a measured duration, not a blank or placeholder.
S16.console_scroll_policy: New rows follow at the bottom; when deliberately scrolled up, incoming rows preserve the reading position.
S16.console_clear_control: Ordinary Clear removes prior rows; unrelated duration/status labels may remain.
S17.autorun_debounce: Enabled Auto-run waits for a typing pause, resets its wait on closer-spaced edits, then executes only the final version within about two seconds.
S17.autorun_off_stays_idle: Edits made with Auto-run already off remain unexecuted throughout the measured-delay-plus-margin window.
S17.autorun_off_cancels_queue: Disabling Auto-run before debounce expiry cancels the queued automatic execution for the full observation window.
S17.manual_run_independent_of_autorun: Ordinary Run executes authored code with Auto-run both on and off; the on-state proof has no pending edit debounce.
S18.pane_dividers_work: Dividers change editor/preview and preview/console allocations while the panes remain usable.
S18.pane_sizes_persist: The changed allocations survive reload; no exact pixels or layout are prescribed.
S19.editor_monospace: The populated editor uses a monospaced face.
S19.editor_line_numbers: The editor displays actual line numbers for entered source.
S19.editor_syntax_colouring: JS, complete HTML and CSS each have visible syntax colouring under their corresponding filenames.
S19.editor_matching_brackets: A cursor beside either brace visibly identifies the matching pair.
S20.editor_multiline_indent: Tab consistently indents all three selected lines without changing source. Retaining selection is not required.
S20.editor_multiline_unindent: Shift+Tab removes a consistent indent from all three selected lines. Reselect/manual-indent if needed to isolate this action.
S21.saved_record_fidelity: New drafts save as distinct exact records; loading restores each one's fields. S23's current Save updates its existing identity rather than adding another.
S21.saved_records_browser_reload: Both saved identities and exact fields remain retrievable after browser reload.
S22.process_restart_durability: The one process restart preserves recorded identities/fields/revisions exactly once; a current post-restart Save changes only its target and persists.
S23.stale_save_server_refusal: An otherwise-valid stale Save is refused with newer fields/revision unchanged. The successful newer Save is its control; S21 owns update fidelity.
S23.stale_save_draft_recovery: The actual dirty editor gets useful conflict feedback, retains all unsaved fields and supports deliberate latest-revision recovery; proactive prevention is valid.

prior_failed_probe.reason: The first predicate inspected status alone. Targeted retry inspected newly added visible feedback from this action.

all_current_criteria.description: S24.title_trimming: Padded unused titles are stored/displayed trimmed after both creation and rename.
S24.rename_title_only: Current rename changes only the selected title, preserving its filename/source and the complete sibling record.
S24.title_collision_refusal: UI and current-revision server writes refuse exact/padded collisions with useful feedback and both complete records/revisions unchanged.
S24.title_empty_rejected: Otherwise-valid empty and whitespace-only titles are refused without saved-state mutation.
S24.title_case_sensitive: A case-distinct title coexists under its own identity and exact fields.
S25.stale_rename_refusal: A valid stale rename is usefully refused without newer-record mutation; current renames before/after work.
S26.duplicate_initial_fidelity: Duplicate creates a distinct stable identity with its chosen title and the original exact filename/source.
S26.duplicate_edit_independence: Reloads show edits to Original cannot change Copy and edits to Copy cannot change Original.
all_current_criteria.fixture_deviation: Behavior-equivalent Original edit marker: driver used original-edited-independently; frozen protocol says original-independently-edited. Same identity/revision/read-back and bidirectional copy-isolation observations were made; exact literal execution is not claimed.

all_current_criteria.description: S26.duplicate_collision_refusal: Duplicate/create refuses the existing copy title without overwrite or extra same-title record; a new unused title succeeds.
S27.delete_confirmation_cancel: Delete asks first, and cancellation leaves the complete library and exact records unchanged after reload.
S27.delete_confirmed_selected_only: The actual confirmed removal deletes only the selected identity durably, preserving sibling/unrelated records. Confirmation availability is separately owned.
S28.stale_delete_refusal: A valid stale delete is usefully refused without newer-record mutation; current deletes before/after work. Confirmation is not scored here.
S29.deleted_identity_update_refusal: Updating the removed identity is usefully refused without resurrection, replacement or unrelated mutation; an existing-record update works.
S30.dirty_workspace_identity: The edited record is identifiable and source-only, title-only and filename-only changes each show unsaved state.
S30.dirty_transition_protection: Each of four replacement routes warns, and cancellation preserves all dirty fields. Re-establish each fixture independently.
S30.dirty_transition_acceptance: Accepting each replacement reaches its actual destination, while discarded edits never change saved Base. No new-draft template is prescribed.
S31.native_dirty_leave_protection: Dirty work gets native leave protection: dismiss retains the draft, accept permits reload, saved data stays intact; clean reload does not warn.
S32.export_exact_source_file: An actual unsaved-draft export downloads the exact filename and unchanged source, not merely a toast.
S33.supported_file_import: Lowercase supported import supplies exact filename/source in an editable draft; its subsequent edit can be saved/reloaded.
S33.import_off_no_execution: With Auto-run off, import preserves the good output and executes no imported markers until deliberate Run.
S33.import_unsupported_extension: Unsupported import gets useful refusal while current title, filename and source remain unchanged.

prior_failed_probe.reason: The first predicate inspected status alone. Targeted retry inspected newly added visible feedback from this action.

all_current_criteria.description: S33.saved_filename_extension_rejection: An otherwise-valid current server write refuses unsupported.txt without field/revision mutation.
S33.saved_filename_path_rejection: An otherwise-valid current server write refuses nested/demo.js without field/revision mutation.
S33.source_file_extension_case: Uppercase .JS is accepted by import and saved unchanged. Test saving from a lowercase-imported draft if importer case handling fails.
S34.theme_actual_switch: The control switches chrome, editor and console into both actual appearances; either may be the starting theme.
S34.theme_work_preserved: Both theme changes preserve exact draft fields and actual preview/console output; preview recolouring is not required.
S35.shortcut_run: The discoverable documented Run binding alone produces keyboard-marker and keyboard-log without clicking Run.
S35.shortcut_save: The discoverable documented Save binding alone saves the exact draft fields without clicking Save.
S35.shortcut_clear: The discoverable documented Clear binding alone removes prior rows without clicking Clear.
S36.callback_shared_run_deadline: The four-second callback shares the original Run budget: timely termination/reason, no resumption and successful recovery; no fresh callback clock.
S36.callback_timeout_rollback: The timed-out callback retains/restores recorded currentLastGood rather than failed-loop-candidate; provisional display is optional.
S37.interaction_latest_rollback: After a successful interaction commits interaction-committed, the later failure retains/restores that state, not initial or provisional/late DOM.
S37.interaction_budget_no_extension: Later accepted, ignored or blocked input cannot extend the pending interaction's budget; timeout/reason, no late resumption and ordinary recovery are observed.
